description: This file is a C++ header defining functions related to inlining autodiff subgraphs within the Torch JIT compiler. It declares a function to check if a node can run with autograd and a function to inline autodiff subgraphs, likely used in graph optimization processes.

methods.name: canRunWithAutograd
methods.description: Checks whether a given JIT node can run with autograd enabled.

methods.name: InlineAutodiffSubgraphs
methods.description: Inlines autodiff subgraphs within a given graph, potentially using a threshold for inlining decisions.
